text: With almost 100 years of combined chocolate manufacturing experience, the Walter Family knows a thing or two about making chocolate. The Walter family’s dream of owning a retail shop came to be over 30 years ago. Prior to Lore’s Chocolates, Tony Sr. made his mark in the industry with several well respected brands in Philadelphia and the southern US. His work with Goldenberg’s Peanut Chews led the family to the eventual purchase of the original Goldenberg Peanut Chews factory – it’s where Lore’s Chocolates are manufactured to this day. You might say it’s a factory with good chocolate karma . Lore’s signature confections are made by hand in small batches and sold at our historic location just one block from the famed Liberty Bell in the heart of Old City Philadelphia. text: Things really kicked into gear on October 7, 1980 when Steven opened the doors to the first Steven Singer Jewelers in the heart of Philadelphia’s Jewelers Row. At just 22 years old, Steven earned the distinction of being the youngest first-generation jeweler on Jeweler’s Row—the oldest (and second largest) jewelry district in the country. And, with his store measuring a scant 8′ by 18′, he also had the distinction of owning the smallest store on the street. He had big ideas and an amusing way of selling exceptional diamonds. The store quickly gained a reputation as the place to go for “The most fun you’ll ever have…buying a diamond.” Contact Info: 739 Walnut Street Philadelphia, PA 19106 215-627-3242 ssj@stevensingerjewelers.com https://www.ihatestevensinger.com/
